Bloodmyst Isle, once named Silvergale by the draenei prior the sickness spread across the land, and before they saw the full damage their crash had caused, is one of the two main islands that make up the Azuremyst Isles. Located off the coast of northern Kalimdor and north of Azuremyst Isle, the island has been ravaged by the radiation from the crashed draenei dimensional ship, the Exodar.
After the vessel's fall on Azeroth, smaller crystals rained down and buried themselves deep in the earth, while the toxic blight stained everything blood red, shaping the Bloodmyst Isle of today. Red crystals now dot the land, and even the great pine trees covering it have taken on a crimson tinge, while the wildlife has been mutated into hostile creatures.

Located off the coast of [[northern Kalimdor]] and north of [[Azuremyst Isle]], the island has been ravaged by the [[Bloodmyst Radiation|radiation]] from the crashed draenei [[dimensional ship]], the ''[[Exodar]]''. After the vessel's fall on [[Azeroth]], smaller crystals rained down and buried themselves deep in the earth, while the toxic blight stained everything blood red, shaping the Bloodmyst Isle of today. Red crystals now dot the land, and even the great pine trees covering it have taken on a crimson tinge, while the wildlife has been mutated into hostile creatures. ==History== ===Early history=== [[File:Ruins of Loreth'Aran.jpg|thumb|The [[Ruins of Loreth'Aran]] on [[Wyrmscar Island]].]] As part of the [[Azuremyst Isles]], the island was long ago a mountainous forest, located on the western edge of [[Kalimdor (landmass)|ancient Kalimdor]]. According to [[draenei]] historians, the land was mostly untamed by the [[Kaldorei Empire]] who left it unsettled on purpose, so that hungry beasts could feed off the land and hunters could trap the choicest prey.''[[World of Warcraft: Exploring Azeroth: Kalimdor]]'', pg. 56 Despite being untamed, it was populated by [[Night elf|night elves]], centered in the large [[city]] of [[Ruins of Loreth'Aran|Loreth'Aran]]. Blessed by the [[green dragonflight]] and its [[Dragon Aspects|Aspect]] [[Ysera]], the [[Dragon Riders of Loreth'Aran]] rode powerful [[green dragon]]s into battle and lived alongside them. During the [[Dragon Wars]], however, the elven city was destroyed when the [[black dragonflight]] descended upon the unwary night elves and green dragons. Led by the fearsome [[Razormaw]], a lieutenant of [[Deathwing]], the [[black dragon]]s wiped out Loreth'Aran and its defenders in a savage maelstrom of flame and death. The city's destruction was made complete by the [[Great Sundering]], as the ocean swept in and the earth erupted, leaving only a few remaining ruins scattered across separate islands. [[Wyrmscar Island]] became home to the restless spirits of slain green whelplings and the ghost of [[Prince Toreth]].[[Prince Toreth#Conversation with Prince Toreth|Prince Toreth's gossip]] In 6 [[ADP]], the ''[[Lost Hope]]'' [[ship]] commanded by [[Captain Edward Hanes]] was sunk on the [[Bloodcursed Reef]] by the [[bloodcurse]], trapping his spirit on [[Wyrmscar Island]].[[The Bloodcurse Legacy]] ===The Burning Crusade=== {{bc-section}} [[File:The Vector Coil.jpg|left|thumb|The [[Vector Coil]], the power core from the ''[[Exodar]]''.]] In Year 26 [[ADP]], when the ''[[Exodar]]'' crashed on [[Azeroth]] and ended its course on the [[Azuremyst Isles]],{{Ref WoWCV3|149|150}} the damaged vessel scattered power crystals across the island,[[Irradiated Crystal Shards]] an event the [[Stillpine tribe|Stillpine]] [[furbolg]]s called the "crystal storm".[[The Kurken is Lurkin']] Blood-like liquid soon seeped from the crystals into the ground and water, while the [[Bloodmyst Radiation|radiations]] mutated both the island's fauna and flore.[[Victims of Corruption]] The ship's crash also released [[Outland]] species into the wild, including the insectoid [[ravager]], forcing the draenei to cull them to maintain the islands' balance.[[Alien Predators]] The draenei [[shaman]] later reported that the [[water elemental]]s were greatly agitated by the corrupted water sources,[[Fouled Water Spirits]] which were polluted by the [[Vector Coil]]'s leaking fluids.[[Don't Drink the Water]] The outpost of [[Blood Watch]] was set up by the [[Hand of Argus]] to find a way to cleanse Bloodmyst's corruption, as well as fight the dangerous creatures loose on the island.[[Hero's Call: Bloodmyst Isle!]] While they showed few signs of mutation at first, the [[Royal Blue Flutterer]]s' corruption got progressively worse, to the point where they damaged nearly everything they came in contact with. After some time, they even began to amplify the damage being done by the crystal shards, leaving the draenei with no other choice but to cull their population.[[Culling the Flutterers]] In time, [[Amberweb Pass]] became the lair of a huge spider called [[Zarakh]], whose spawn grew to unnatural sizes due to contamination by the spaceship debris.[[The Missing Expedition]] The water elemental [[Aqueous]] eventually discovered that the aquatic corruption was the by-product of [[Tel'athion the Impure]], a demented researcher, who produced the filth that had been seeping into the island's water. After the [[shaman]] heroes destroyed the cache of contaminated barrels, they decapitated the mad [[blood elf]], putting in motion the restoration of the water on Bloodmyst Isle over time.[[Call of Water (Exodar, 5)]] During their offensive against the draenei, the [[Sunhawk]] [[Blood elf|blood elves]] were led by the [[man'ari eredar]] [[Sironas]], who planned to use the ship's [[Vector Coil]] to create a [[Sun Gate]] and receive [[Sunfury]] reinforcements from Outland. Seeking to reclaim the ''Exodar''[[Traitor's Communication]] and corrupt draenei into man'ari,[[What We Don't Know...]] the group was ultimately disbanded by [[Alliance]] [[adventurer]]s sent by the [[Hand of Argus]].[[Ending Their World]] {{Clrl}} ===Exploring Azeroth=== {{novel-section}} After the [[Fourth War]] in 34 ADP, when the [[Horde Council]] sent [[Zekhan]] and [[Rexxar]] to look over their holdings across [[Kalimdor]], Velen extended them an invitation to the Azuremyst Isles, where they were assigned an escort consisting of [[Ya'rika]] and [[Kea'ton]] while visiting the ''[[Exodar]]'' and the region.''[[World of Warcraft: Exploring Azeroth: Kalimdor]]'', pg. 58 Despite their efforts, the draenei couldn't clear away the [[Bloodmyst Radiation|toxic blight]] that had been spoiled over both islands.''[[World of Warcraft: Exploring Azeroth: Kalimdor]]'', pg. 56 Upon visiting Bloodmyst Isle, Zekhan reported that the beasts of Bloodmyst were badly weakened from the toxins, and that not much wildlife has been spared from the illness over the years.''[[World of Warcraft: Exploring Azeroth: Kalimdor]]'', pg. 66 ===Dragonflight=== {{df-section}} [[File:At the Source - Light explosion.jpg|thumb|[[Velen|Prophet Velen]] and [[Chieftain Hatuun|Hatuun]] destroy the [[fel spreader]]s across Bloodmyst Isle with their [[magic]]s.]] In Year 40 ADP, while the ''[[Exodar]]'' was prepared for the [[Tishamaat]], the [[Nazzivus]] [[satyr]]s attacked draenei pilgrims traveling for the celebrations. Rather than mobilizing the [[vindicator]]s and alarm his people in the process, [[Velen|Prophet Velen]] gathered [[Hatuun]], [[Arzaal]], and the [[draenei]] [[adventurer]] at his side to strop the threat. Upon arriving, Arzaal expressed that the island's corruption felt strange, making it difficult to cleanse.[[Emergency Efforts]] When Hatuun questioned why the corruption was running rampant, Velen admitted that he hadn't foreseen it and had pulled the [[Rangari]] out of the region in order to protect them. The group eventually discovered that [[demon]]s had been spreading [[fel]], keeping the island corrupted and preventing it from healing even years after the ''Exodar'''s crash.[[Excision]] After the group defeated [[Sironas]] and the satyrs, they [[Light]]-empowered an [[Arkonite Generator]] to cleanse hundreds of [[fel spreader]]s across the island.[[At the Source]] With the corruption removed, Velen claimed that Bloodmyst could now finally begin to heal.[[At the Source]] ==Getting there== ;{{Alliance}} Alliance: Bloodmyst Isle is only accessible from [[Azuremyst Isle]], which can only be reached by boat from [[Rut'theran Village]] in [[Teldrassil]]. Since {{g|cata}}, there is also a [[flight path]] that connects the village to [[Azure Watch]] on Azuremist Isle, which in turn is connected to [[Blood Watch]]. ;{{Horde}} Horde: Members of the Horde who want to visit Bloodmyst Isle must first hijack a boat from the Alliance-aligned Rut'theran, sail to Azuremyst Isle, then head north to Bloodmyst Isle. ==Geography== Bloodmyst Isle lies off the west coast of northern [[Kalimdor]]. The island is divided into two sections by a narrow strip of water. The smaller section, which is connected by a bridge to [[Azuremyst Isle]], is yet untainted by the red mist that covers the main part of the island. There are no instanced dungeons or battlegrounds on Bloodmyst Isle. The micro dungeon, the [[Vector Coil]], can be found here. [[Blood Watch]] serves as the zone's travel hub, connecting it to [[Azuremyst Isle]]. ===Maps and subregions=== [[File:WorldMap-BloodmystIsle.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of Bloodmyst Isle.]] {| class="darktable hlist" |- | *[[Amberweb Pass]] *[[Axxarien]] *[[Beryl Coast]] *[[Blacksilt Shore]] *[[Bladewood]] *[[Blood Watch]] *[[Bloodcurse Isle]] *[[Bloodcursed Reef|The Bloodcursed Reef]] *[[Bloodwash|The Bloodwash]] *[[Bristlelimb Enclave]] *[[Crimson Reach|The Crimson Reach]] *[[Cryo-Core|The Cryo-Core]] *[[Foul Pool|The Foul Pool]] *[[Hidden Reef|The Hidden Reef]] *[[Kessel's Crossing]] *[[Lost Fold|The Lost Fold]] *[[Middenvale]] *[[Mystwood]] *[[Nazzivian]] *[[Ragefeather Ridge]] *[[Ruins of Loreth'Aran]] *[[Talon Stand]] *[[Tel'athion's Camp]] *[[Veiled Sea|The Veiled Sea]] *[[Vector Coil|The Vector Coil]] *[[Veridian Point]] *[[Vindicator's Rest]] *[[Warp Piston|The Warp Piston]] *[[Wrathscale Lair]] *[[Wyrmscar Island]] |} {{clear|left}} ===Travel hubs=== [[File:Blood Watch.jpg|thumb|[[Blood Watch]], the [[Hand of Argus]] forward outpost.]] The only travel hub on Bloodmyst Isle is Alliance aligned [[Blood Watch]].
